linkPeople.title: Link two people
linkPeople.hint: Select two existing people in the tree and specify how they are related.

editPerson.title: Edit person
editPerson.noPartners: No recorded spouses or partners yet.
editPerson.lineagesHint: Automatically created from surname and maiden/birth surname upon saving. You can uncheck non-matching ones or add custom ones.

editPerson.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete <1>{{name}}</1>? They will be moved to the trash — you can restore them later if made by mistake.

lineagesManage.title: Manage lineages
lineagesManage.hint: Rename or delete lineages in this tree. Deleting a lineage does not delete people, it only removes the grouping.
lineagesManage.deriveHint: Also automatically merges lineages that only differ by gender endings of the surname (e.g., Jasiurkowski/Jasiurkowska).
lineagesManage.deriveDoneWithMerge: Done — {{count}} lineages in total ({{merged}} merged due to gender variants).

duplicates.title: Duplicate people
duplicates.manualHint: Select any two people to compare and merge them.
duplicates.familiesHint: Remnants of single-parent family links that already have another complete relationship with the same person — usually from an older import.

mergeReview.title: Merge people
mergeReview.noConflicts: There are no differences between these two profiles — only their relationships (family, lineages, photos) will be merged.
mergeReview.warning: This action cannot easily be undone: the discarded profile moves to trash and loses its relationships, which have already been transferred to the retained profile.
